summary: Independent verification of the 'nexifyai' wrapper-script bugfix on the external NeXify AI Platform (https://app.nexifyai.cloud). All 4 backend tests PASSED in 152.81s. Login (better-auth), agent listing, Developer agent wakeup+run, and CEO agent regression run all succeeded end-to-end. The previously reported error 'Failed to start command "nexifyai" in "."' is fully resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Adapter execution code lives on VPS (paperclip-nexify container /app/server/node_modules/hermes-paperclip-adapter/dist/server/execute.js) - not in local /app repo. Ensure the docker-committed image containing the /usr/local/bin/nexifyai wrapper is what the production deployment pulls (verify container image tag/digest is pinned to the committed version, otherwise a restart could revert the fix).
Recommend adding a startup-time sanity check inside the paperclip container: `command -v nexifyai || echo 'MISSING WRAPPER'` in an entrypoint hook, so silent regressions are surfaced immediately.

seed_data_creation: None. Two real heartbeat runs were created against production as part of verification: Developer run e757cff9-583a-48f0-8e7c-ec2d0e5cd87d (succeeded, exitCode 0) and CEO run a6be2152-7385-4898-9983-de0736f29d1c (succeeded, exitCode 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: External target only (https://app.nexifyai.cloud) - the local /app FastAPI backend is NOT under test. All POST /wakeup requests REQUIRE 'Origin: https://app.nexifyai.cloud' header (otherwise 403 'Board mutation requires trusted browser origin'). Session cookie is __Secure-* prefixed and only works over HTTPS. Agent runs perform real LLM work and can take 1-4 minutes. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_nexify_agent_wakeup.py.

rca of the issue.bug: Agent 'NeXify AI Developer' failed with 'Failed to start command "nexifyai" in "."' because the hermes adapter (execute.js) spawns `nexifyai chat -q ... -Q` but no `nexifyai` binary was on PATH inside the paperclip-nexify container.
rca of the issue.fix_applied_by_main_agent: Created /usr/local/bin/nexifyai wrapper script inside the container and persisted the change via `docker commit` into the image.
rca of the issue.verification: Testing agent independently signed in via better-auth, POSTed to /api/agents/{developerId}/wakeup with Origin header, polled /api/heartbeat-runs/{id} until terminal state. Result: status='succeeded', exitCode=0, error=null. No occurrence of 'Failed to start command' in the run's error field. Regression run on CEO agent (which uses cmd 'hermes' instead of 'nexifyai') also succeeded, confirming no collateral damage.
rca of the issue.mitigation_recommendation: Bake the wrapper into the Dockerfile (not just docker-commit) and pin the image digest in the deployment manifest to prevent regression on future rebuilds.
